segment_summary: এই অংশে লালকেল্লার জাঁকজমকপূর্ণ স্থাপত্যের বর্ণনা দেওয়া হয়, যা একসময় মুঘল সাম্রাজ্যের অদম্য শক্তির প্রতীক ছিল।

segment_enrichment.angle: The silent geometry of the Red Fort's façade mirroring an internal collapse.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Scene: The Diwan-i-Khas balcony at dawn. Desire: To issue one final, symbolic decree that holds meaning internally only. Obstacle: A junior officer subtly suggests adherence to new regulations. Turn: He instead dips his pen in ink reserved for personal verse.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Treating the 'Title' itself as a physical, oppressive object rather than just an abstract concept.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The coarse grit of sandstone under evening lamp-glow (touch/sight).
segment_enrichment.research_question: What were common Mughal courtly phrases that represented abstract 'sovereignty' before British encroachment?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: A framing device using an imagined scribe recording the Emperor's changing internal landscape.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike later chapters dealing with exile or bloodshed, this section establishes the fragile beauty of power just before its systemic rot sets in.
